info.title: [V-TD09] Shinemon Nitta ｜ ｜ Card List ｜ Cardfight!! Vanguard Trading Card Game | Official Website

cards.text:
V-TD09/001EN
Gleaming Lord, Uranus
Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[CONT](VC):If your (VC) has five or more force markers, your back row center circle becomes an Astral Plane. (Only an Astral Deity can be on an Astral Plane)
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Soul-Blast 2], get an Imaginary Gift:Force, and put that marker on your (VC).

V-TD09/002EN
Perseus of Probity
Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](VC/RC):When it attacks a vanguard, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], draw two cards, and put a card from your hand into your soul.

V-TD09/003EN
White-clothed Sorcerer, Colts
Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 10000
-

V-TD09/004EN
Prometheus of Dancing Lights
Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, look at two cards from the top of your deck, put one card from among them into your soul, and put one card from among them on the top of your deck.
[AUTO](RC):When it attacks, if your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, one of your vanguards and this unit get [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

V-TD09/005EN
Parthenos of Holy Verse
Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 2｜ Power 9000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO](RC):When it attacks while boosted, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], if your vanguard is an <Astral Poet>, get an Imaginary Gift:Force, and put that marker on your (VC).

V-TD09/006EN
Diana of Moonlight
Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](RC):When the attack it boosted hits, [COST][Counter-Blast 1 &[Soul-Blast 1], get an Imaginary Gift:Force, put that marker on your (VC), and if your vanguard is an <Astral Poet>, [Counter-Charge 1].

V-TD09/007EN
Atlas of Heavenly Sphere
Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO](VC):When placed, [Soul-Charge 1].
[ACT](RC):[COST][Counter-Blast 1 & Put this unit into your soul], draw a card, and if your vanguard is an <Astral Poet>, get an Imaginary Gift:Force, and put that marker on your (VC).

V-TD09/008EN
Administrator of Hope, Pandora
Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO](GC):When placed, [COST][discard a card from your hand], and one of your units cannot be hit until end of that battle.

V-TD09/009EN
Ambrosial Snake
Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 1｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 10000
[ACT](RC)[1/turn]:[COST][Soul-Blast 5], get an Imaginary Gift:Force, and put that marker on your (VC).

V-TD09/010EN
Pan of New Style
Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 10000
[AUTO]:When rode upon, draw a card.

Battle Maiden, Kukurihime
Trigger Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000

Goddess of Self-sacrifice, Kushinada
Trigger Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO](GC):When placed, [COST][discard a card from your hand], and one of your units cannot be hit until end of that battle.

V-TD09/015EN
Witch of Big Pots, Laurier
Trigger Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 20000
(You may only have up to four cards with "[Heal] HEAL" in a deck.)

V-TD09/016EN
Giant Deity of Distant World, Valkerion
Normal Unit｜ Cray Elemental｜ Grade 5｜ Power 70000｜ Shield -
[CONT]:This card cannot be ridden.
[AUTO]:When on a non-Astral Plane circle, retire this unit. If it could not be retired, remove this unit.
[AUTO](RC):When placed from hand, look at five cards from the top of your deck, put one card from among them into your drop zone, and until end of turn, this unit's drive is the same as the grade of the card put into your drop zone. Shuffle your deck.

Normal Unit｜ Genesis｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[CONT](VC):If your (VC) has five or more force markers, your back row center circle becomes an Astral Plane. (Only an Astral Deity can be on an Astral Plane)
[AUTO](VC/RC):When placed, [COST][Soul-Blast 2], get an Imaginary Gift:Force, and put that marker on your (VC).
